findings.issue: The existence of a continuous argument lift (γ t - w = ‖·‖·exp(I θ), θ continuous) duplicates `Complex.exists_continuousOn_eqOn_exp_comp`, whose `Im f` is a continuous real arg lift for a continuous nowhere-zero function on an open simply connected set; the PR description claims Mathlib has nothing to reuse.

summary: One private helper directly re-derives an existing Mathlib slitPlane lemma; the main lift's existence core overlaps Mathlib's continuous log-branch theorem, which the PR's 'no theory to reuse' claim overlooks.
